summary: Claims must be on-label, substantiated, and balanced.

sections.heading: Materials and claims
bullets: Use only claims supported by the current prescribing information (PI) or approved references.
Fair balance: risk information must be reasonably comparable to benefit presentation.
HCP sites and emails typically require ISI / important safety information in line with client standards.
Do not promise off-label use, superiority without substantiation, or approval outcomes.
